lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Al2Ag6 (reduced formula Ba4AlAg3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ag and Al centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Ba centers have 12 neighbors (4 Ag, 4 Al, 4 Ba), with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.19 to 3.61 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ba-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Ag- and Ba-centered polyhedra.
